# A small fixture with NO symmetry, for orientation and edge tests.
#
# The Omarchy logo is nearly mirror-symmetric, so a harness that flipped rows or
# columns would score it almost perfectly — a flip is invisible there. This one is an
# "L" with a stroke off its top, a lone shade block, and a colour gradient that runs
# a different way on every row, so a vertical flip, a horizontal flip and a transpose
# each produce a different cell array. Every glyph family the metric models is here:
# full block, both half blocks, and a shade block.
#
# `order top-down` means the FIRST fenced line is the TOP of the picture — the way a
# person reads it. `order bottom-up` is TTE's native row order (row 1 at the bottom),
# so a producer dumping a ttfx grid can write rows in the order it walks them and say
# so, instead of remembering to flip. Format: native/organon-render/src/legibility.rs.
grid v1
cols 5
rows 3
aspect 2
order top-down
default #ffffff
colour r #ff3000
colour o #ff9000
colour y #ffe000
colour g #40ff60
colour b #4090ff
glyphs
|█▀   |
|█  ▒ |
|█▄▄█ |
colours
|ro   |
|y  b |
|gobr |
